chars.A: ANAS: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogger pants and white sneakers.
chars.L: LOKMAN: a tall broad muscular young man wearing a red tracksuit with white side stripes, a thick gold chain and black sliders, arms crossed, tough attitude.
chars.M: MERIEM: a pretty young woman wearing a lilac hijab, a light denim jacket and a long beige skirt.
chars.Y: YOUSSEF: a young man wearing a black bucket hat, an oversized white t-shirt and baggy blue jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a sunny street of Ouarzazate with earth-colored kasbah walls, LOKMAN blocks the way and glares angrily at ANAS, who holds MERIEM's hand and looks nervous; MERIEM looks annoyed at LOKMAN. Open tension between the two men, slightly comic.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: LOKMAN leans proudly on an old shiny black car in a dusty Ouarzazate street at sunset, posing like a movie gangster, chin up, very self-important, comic.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a simple rented room with a mattress on the floor and a small window, ANAS and YOUSSEF sit on the floor laughing hard, YOUSSEF holding his belly, ANAS pointing at a bowl of white bean stew (loubia) on a low round table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At night in a narrow alley of Ouarzazate lit by one street lamp, LOKMAN stands next to a scooter cracking his knuckles with a menacing look, cats running away.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Daytime terrace of a small Moroccan café: ANAS and MERIEM sit at a table sharing mint tea and smiling at each other in the foreground, while in the background LOKMAN watches them from across the street with a jealous furious face.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At night in the rented room, ANAS sits on a mattress holding his phone with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open in shock at a threatening message, phone screen glowing on his face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ANAS sits on the mattress in the rented room, covering his mouth with one hand, embarrassed awkward grin, phone in the other hand, comic.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: ANAS lies relaxed on the mattress in the rented room with hands behind his head, laughing carelessly; behind him through the small open window at night the dark silhouette of LOKMAN is watching him.
